headline: Approved Nursing/SPED staff budget transfer and FY 2026 final budget adjustment; recommended FY 2027 state budget adjustment.
summary: Officials said the district fell about $500,000 short of its required FY26 Net School Spending, and that amount will go into the FY27 budget. The overall appropriation is decreasing by $459,890, mainly because of lower charter school reimbursement. Members tabled the FY28 budget calendar after questioning whether its dates matched scheduled meetings.
decisions: Approved the Nursing/ SPED Staff Budget Transfer, passed unanimously.
Approved the FY 2026 Final Budget Adjustment, passed unanimously.
Recommended the FY 2027 State Final Budget Adjustment to the full School Committee, passed unanimously.
Tabled the Draft Proposed FY28 Budget Calendar, passed unanimously.
Approved the September 27 SC Financial Report, passed unanimously.
Approved the FY 28 SC Draft Budget Priorities, passed unanimously.
Approved the minutes of the 9.15.26 Finance and Operations Meeting, passed unanimously.
